WITH tgt AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
ho AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tgt) tgt_n, (SELECT count(*) FROM ho) ho_n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM tgt JOIN ho USING(member_id)) overlap,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15 AND contact_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-23 22:00:00') early,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15 AND contact_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00') late,
 (SELECT min(contact_ts_utc) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) mn,
 (SELECT max(contact_ts_utc) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) mx,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT exposure_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) dist_exp,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15 AND NOT delivered) undelivered,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND NOT m.marketing_consent) noconsent

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE member_key IS NOT NULL) n_mem,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel_code='WB') n_wb_code,
 min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) d_etl
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-12-14'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, m.member_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id,
         COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL AS is_web
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND NOT (s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)),
win AS (SELECT * FROM lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07'),
tgt AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
ho AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
spend AS (SELECT member_id, SUM(net_amount) sp FROM win GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'tgt' g, count(*) n, SUM(COALESCE(sp,0)) tot, AVG(COALESCE(sp,0)) avg, count(sp) buyers FROM tgt LEFT JOIN spend USING(member_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ho', count(*), SUM(COALESCE(sp,0)), AVG(COALESCE(sp,0)), count(sp) FROM ho LEFT JOIN spend USING(member_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)), sum(CASE WHEN is_web THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM win
UNION ALL SELECT 'weblines_ordered_misc', count(*), SUM(net_amount), min(net_amount), max(net_amount) FROM win

WITH tgt AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
ho AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
grp AS (SELECT member_id,'tgt' g FROM tgt UNION ALL SELECT member_id,'ho' FROM ho),
v AS (SELECT g.g, g.member_id, m.join_date, m.tier, m.marketing_consent, m.home_store_id FROM grp g JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=g.member_id AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to)
SELECT g, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) dm,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date > DATE '2025-11-24') joined_after,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT marketing_consent) no_consent_start,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Gold') gold, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Silver') silver, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Basic') basic,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE home_store_id=900) online
FROM v GROUP BY g
